label: Open with Notoir
title: File-manager integration
mac: In Finder, select files or folders, then use Services → Open with Notoir.
windows: In Explorer, right-click files, folders, or a folder background. Windows 11: Show more options → Open with Notoir.
linux: Supported: Nautilus (Scripts) and Dolphin (Actions). Other file managers are not supported.

associations.title: File Associations
associations.description: Choose the file types that open with Notoir by default.
associations.linked: Extensions sharing an operating-system file type change together.
associations.windows: Windows will open Default Apps. Confirm the changes there, then return and refresh.
associations.partial: Changes already applied will remain if you cancel.
associations.pending: Some changes still need confirmation. Review system defaults, then refresh.
